name: synthetics
description: Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics You can use Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics to continually monitor your services.

subcommands.name: associate-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a canary with a group.

options.name: --group-identifier
options.description: Specifies the group.

options.name: --resource-arn
options.description: The ARN of the canary that you want to associate with the specified group

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: create-canary
subcommands.description: Creates a canary.

options.name: --name
options.description: The name for this canary.

options.name: --code
options.description: A structure that includes the entry point from which the canary should start running your script.

options.name: --artifact-s3-location
options.description: The location in Amazon S3 where Synthetics stores artifacts from the test runs of this canary.

options.name: --execution-role-arn
options.description: The ARN of the IAM role to be used to run the canary.

options.name: --schedule
options.description: A structure that contains information about how often the canary is to run and when these test runs are to stop

options.name: --run-config
options.description: A structure that contains the configuration for individual canary runs, such as timeout value and environment variables.

options.name: --success-retention-period-in-days
options.description: The number of days to retain data about successful runs of this canary.

options.name: --failure-retention-period-in-days
options.description: The number of days to retain data about failed runs of this canary.

options.name: --runtime-version
options.description: Specifies the runtime version to use for the canary.

options.name: --vpc-config
options.description: If this canary is to test an endpoint in a VPC, this structure contains information about the subnet and security groups of the VPC endpoint.

options.name: --resources-to-replicate-tags
options.description: To have the tags that you apply to this canary also be applied to the Lambda function that the canary uses, specify this parameter with the value lambda-function.

options.name: --provisioned-resource-cleanup
options.description: Specifies whether to also delete the Lambda functions and layers used by this canary when the canary is deleted.

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of key-value pairs to associate with the canary.

options.name: --artifact-config
options.description: A structure that contains the configuration for canary artifacts, including the encryption-at-rest settings for artifacts that the canary uploads to Amazon S3

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
